headline: Argentina Grain Exchange Issues Severe Weather Alert for Key Agricultural Hubs
summary: The Buenos Aires Grain Exchange warned of volatile weather through December 2, including rainfall exceeding 100 millimeters in La Pampa and temperatures spiking to 45°C. Surrounding regions expect minimal precipitation.
why: Argentina is one of the world's primary exporters of processed soybean oil, meal, and corn.

impacts.name: Soybeans
impacts.why: Extreme heat and erratic rainfall patterns threaten grain yield projections in key growing zones.
